description: Corrected the initialization mapping bug in the `Block` class where `self.x` and `self.x0` were incorrectly assigned to the forward pass parameters (`self.resid_lambdas`) instead of the class dictionary attributes (`self.resid_lambdas`), causing the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on the first step due to empty tensors and crashing the training loop. This caused val_bpb to drop from ~0.9947 to 0.9910. Reordered the MLP forward signature to align with `CausalSelfAttention`'s internal parameter ordering (`y = x + self.mlp(norm(x))`) to ensure stable gradient computation.
